The Petitioners are accused for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code in which the charge sheet has already been filed.

Their petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (hereinafter called the Code) has 16:41:52 IST Reason:
been dismissed by the High Court.
Presently, we have been informed that the trial is proceeding before the Court concerned.
Under these circumstances, we see absolutely no reason to interfere with the matter considering that on a bare perusal of the subject FIR, the offences as alleged are made out.

We say nothing on the merits of the case but for the purposes of quashing, we are totally in agreement with the High Court that it is not a case where extraordinary jurisdiction of the High Court ought to have been exercised under Section 482 of the Code and therefore, we dismiss the present petition along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
